bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
service=gace-userbot-verify.service
active="$(systemctl --user is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)"
enabled="$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)"
linger="$(loginctl show-user gace -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test "$active" != active;then echo USERBOT_RESIDENT=NOT_ACTIVE;exit 61;fi
if test "$enabled" != enabled;then echo USERBOT_RESIDENT=NOT_ENABLED;exit 62;fi
if test "$linger" != yes;then echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_LINGER=NOT_VERIFIED;exit 63;fi
# Discover the adopted owner interface without opening an independent session
# or reading a Telegram credential/session file.
count="$(find /home/gace/Project/Gserver -maxdepth 8 -type f \( -name 'userbot_keepalive.py' -o -name '*userbot*test*client*.py' -o -name '*userbot*ipc*.py' \) -print 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
test "$count" -gt 0 || exit 64
unit="$(systemctl --user show "$service" -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
test -n "$unit" || exit 65
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_ACTIVE=PASS
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_ENABLED=PASS
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_LINGER=PASS
echo USERBOT_OWNER_CLIENT_FILES_PRESENT=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_ACCESSED=NO
echo USERBOT_NEW_LOGIN=NO
